`Path: 业务对象与记录 —— 种子数据原样落库,重放不多不少 | platform-core.seed-integrity(P0)· seed-mode-matrix(P1) | P② | p1`
Graded by the triage seat (`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`) at 2026-09-22T18:46Z. ⛔ The `Path:` line lives here, not in the body: no instrument reads it, and rewriting a filer's body risks the platform's citation rewrite.

⭐ **The highest-consequence card of this sweep, and the grade is deliberately conservative — read the escalation condition below.**

**Class (a), and this seat verified all three mechanism sites on `origin/main`** (the filer's two-vs-one probe is its own; ⛔ this seat did not re-run it):

| site | reading |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/runtime/src/artifact-collections.ts` | `itemIdentity()` recognises an item by `name`; a **dataset has none**, so it falls back to whole-value identity — which registration stamps (`_packageId` / `_provenance`) then break |
| `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts:1355` | the legacy-additive path guards by **reference only** — `manifest.data !== this.collections.data` — so a stamped copy is contributed beside the unstamped one |
| `packages/runtime/src/seed-datasets.ts` | `list.push(...datasets)` is a plain push; nothing de-duplicates downstream |

⇒ on any artifact built before #14512, a `mode:'insert'` dataset is applied **twice per boot**.

### ⚠️ Why p1 and not p3, and the condition under which it is p0

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` carries **`platform-core.seed-integrity` at priority P0**, and its clause is 「row counts match the authored seed … replay is idempotent」 — which is **exactly** what a doubled insert falsifies. By 定级判据's first state (项会 fail ⇒ 继承该项档) this inherits **P0**.

**This seat grades it p1 rather than p0 for one measured reason**: the population is 「an artifact built before #14512」, and ⛔ this seat did not confirm a live artifact in that state. **The dispatch's FIRST act is to settle that**, and the answer moves the grade:
- a legacy-additive artifact is reachable on an upgrade path ⇒ **this is p0**, re-grade before writing any code;
- it is not reachable ⇒ p1 stands, and the card says so with the reading.

⛔ Do not let that open question defer the card. 优先级 1 是数据完整性, and a doubled insert is the shape that rule exists for.

**Dedupe** — #15262 (closed) is the **same file, different mechanism**: it added the reference guard at `:1355` that this card is the residual of. 同族异缺陷 ⇒ ⛔ 不并. #3434 (closed) is insert-mode replay by another route.
